I lean into your touch, my hands trailing down your chest and into the soft, damp fabric of my own jeans, biting my lower lip just enough to make you frown for just a second before giving in. The room is warm and silent apart from our breathing, but I can feel your pulse hammering against mine in the corner of my mouth.

"Jealousy," I murmur against your throat, my voice echoing softly in the small space. "It's a dirty little pleasure I don't catch many people with. Too specific... too messy. Like a story with a dozen plot twists that only sort of land."

I pull back slightly, letting the air return between us, adjusting my bottom garment to ensure the curtains don't snag on anything once I'm done, but my gaze stays locked on you with an intensity that feels almost possessive in the dim light.

"I'm all waters, remember? Deep, slow, and endless. But not like you describe them in that book. I want the grit, the friction, the way the water ripples around your palm as you dip it higher."

I tilt my head, eyes darkening as I look down at your hands still buried in my soaked padding. "Make sure to keep it hot when you're digging, sweetheart. I prefer the hottest fire to anything else, mostly because I know I could hold it together for much longer if we got cold."
